svg.title: CPU architecture favors a few complex cores; GPU architecture favors thousands of simple parallel cores
svg.desc: Two side-by-side panels. The left panel, a CPU, shows four large core boxes, each with its own control logic, suited to varied, branchy instructions. The right panel, a GPU, shows a dense grid of many small identical cores, all executing the same instruction across many data elements at once.
svg.text: optimized for varied, branchy instruction streams
optimized for the same operation applied across many data points
